widgets.name: AI Usage
widgets.description: A no-code widget showing how many AI sessions, requests and active minutes you have, in six variants. Three numbers only, never prompts or content.
widgets.summary: Shows counts and timings of your local coding-agent sessions today, never what was said in them.

widgets.name: Battery
widgets.description: Battery charge, state and time left as a ring, bar, big number, bar chip or detailed card. Spec widget: JSON only, no code.
widgets.summary: Shows battery charge, whether it is charging, and the estimated time left.

widgets.name: Clock
widgets.description: A no-code clock with six variants: digital, digital with seconds, minimal, date focus, bar chip and stacked time, date and zone.
widgets.summary: Shows the time and date as digital, analog or binary numerals, or as several world time zones.

widgets.name: Docker
widgets.description: Container counts at a glance. Spec widget with no code and six layout variants: counts, health, names, detailed, minimal and a bar chip.
widgets.summary: Shows how many containers are running, stopped or unhealthy, read-only.

widgets.name: GitHub activity
widgets.description: Your open pull requests and the ones waiting for your review, as two numbers. Spec widget with no code and five layout variants. Needs the GitHub provider, which is not built yet.
widgets.summary: Shows how many of your pull requests are open and how many reviews are waiting for you.

secrets: a github credential kept in your vault (the widget never sees it)

widgets.name: System monitor
widgets.description: CPU, memory and load at a glance. Spec widget with no code and eight layout variants: rings, bars, a two-bar view, a full view with load averages, a numbers-only view, a bar chip, and one separate variant that needs the not-yet-served temperature field.
widgets.summary: Shows CPU load, memory use and temperature, with a short history graph when the widget is tall enough.

data: system.cpu, system.memory, system.load, system.temp: usage_pct, used_pct, used_mib, total_mib, load1, load5, load15, celsius

widgets.name: Tasks
widgets.description: Open tasks, tasks due today and a short task list as a list, counts, chip, minimal or detailed card. Spec widget: JSON only, no code.
widgets.summary: Shows your open tasks and how many are due today, from a local task file.
